expected_summary: Pfizer 2023 10Q filing (Health Care sector). An accurate summary must be consistent with these reported figures: How much does Pfizer expect to pay to spin off Upjohn in the future in USD million? -> 77.78; For Pfizer, which geographic region had the biggest drop in Q22023 year over year revenues (on a percentage basis)? -> Developed Rest of the World; As of Q2'2023, is Pfizer spinning off any large business segments? -> Yes, it's spinning off Upjohn.

expected_facts.question: How much does Pfizer expect to pay to spin off Upjohn in the future in USD million?
expected_facts.justification: 10% cost is remaining amount in the future. Calculation: 700/9 is 10% of the cost remaining
expected_facts.evidence_excerpt: We expect to incur costs of approximately $700 million in connection with separating Upjohn, of which approximately 90% has been incurred since inception and through the second quarter of 2023. These charges include costs and expenses related to separation of legal entities and transaction costs.
